questions.question: The below table shows the number of trees of 3 different fruits, planted during 2018- 2022. Study the table carefully and answer the question based on it. Year Jackfruit Mango Butter Fruit 2018 35,000 40,000 55,000 2019 38,000 48,000 58,000 2020 42,000 52,000 62,000 2021 45,000 55,000 65,000 2022 48,000 58,000 68,000 What was the percentage increase in the number of mango trees planted in 2020 compared to the number of mango trees planted in 2018?
questions.questionHtml:
The below table shows the number of trees of 3 different fruits, planted during 2018- 2022. Study the table carefully and answer the question based on it.

Year Jackfruit Mango Butter Fruit
2018 35,000 40,000 55,000
2019 38,000 48,000 58,000
2020 42,000 52,000 62,000
2021 45,000 55,000 65,000
2022 48,000 58,000 68,000

What was the percentage increase in the number of mango trees planted in 2020 compared to the number of mango trees planted in 2018?
questions.solution:
Given:

A table showing the number of trees of 3 different fruits, planted during 2018- 2022.

Formula used:

Percentage increase = (Mango in 2020 - Mango in 2018) / Mango in 2018 × 100

Calculation:

Percentage increase = (52000 - 40000) / 40000 × 100 

⇒ 12000 / 40000 × 100

⇒ 30%

∴ The correct answer is 30%.

questions.solution:

What are the total sales of cars of the four manufacturers under consideration in the city in the entire period of 6 years (from 2015 to 2020)?
questions.solution:
Given:- A data in a tabulated form where sales of car from 2015 to 2020 by different manufacturers are mentioned and all the figures are in thousands

To find:-  total sales of cars from 2015 to 2020

Concept used:- Basic addition of values

Calculation:- Total sales in year 2015 = 44 + 40 + 36 + 48 = 168

Total sales in year 2016 = 48 + 41 + 38 + 44 = 171 

Total sales of cars 2017 = 47 + 41 + 40 + 44 = 172

Total sales of cars 2018 = 50 + 41 + 42 + 42 = 175

Total sales of cars 2019 = 52 + 42 + 44 + 42 = 180

Total sales of cars 2020 =  51 + 43 + 50 + 43 =  187

Total sales from 2015 to 2020 = 168 + 171 + 172 + 175 + 180 + 187 

⇒Total sales from 2015 to 2020 = (170 - 2) + (170 +1)+ (170 + 2) + (170 + 5)  + (180) + (180 + 7) 

⇒Total sales from 2015 to 2020 = 170 × 4 + 180 × 2 + (8 - 2 + 7) = 1053

Since the figures were in thousands,

⇒Total sales from 2015 to 2020 = 1053 × 1000 = 1053000

The total sales of cars of the four manufacturers under consideration in the city in the entire period of 6 years is 1053000

questions.solution:
Given:- A data set comprised of the number of girls and boys in different class

To find:- % of the number of boys in comparison with the average number of girls per class

Formula used:- Average = \(\frac{total \ outcome}{total \ number\ of\ outcome}\)

Calculations:- Average of the number of girls in 5 sections = \(\frac{Total\ number\ of\ girls}{Number\ of\ sections}\)

⇒Average = \(\frac{25+20+25+32+24}{5}\) = \(\frac{126}{5}\)

⇒Average = 25.20

% boys in C5 to average of girls in school = \(\frac{Number\ of\ boys\ in\ C5}{Average\ number\ of\ girls}\times100\)

⇒% boys in C5 to average of girls in school = \(\frac{26}{25.20}\times 100\) 

⇒% boys in C5 to average of girls in school = 103.17%

 

.·.The number of boys in C5 is approximately what percent of the average number of girls per class is 103.17%

There are four months January, February, March and April in which the number of computers sold by dealer B was less than the average number of computers sold by dealer C in six months.

questions.question: What is the ratio of the total exports of item A in 2014 and 2015 to the total export of item C in 2011 and 2015?
questions.questionHtml: What is the ratio of the total exports of item A in 2014 and 2015 to the total export of item C in 2011 and 2015?
questions.solution:
Total exports of items A in 2014 and 2015 = 425 + 400 = 825

Total export of item C in 2011 and 2015 = 244 + 306 = 550

∴ Required ratio = 825 : 550 = 3 : 2
